metadata.title: Gurugram District Government Offices and Officials Telephone Directory
metadata.coverage_note: A broad, source-backed public directory assembled from government websites and official public PDFs available during research. It cannot honestly be certified as every office or every serving official: some government pages publish no phone number, some departments maintain separate internal directories, and officeholders/contact numbers change.
data_policy: Only publicly published official office telephone numbers and official-duty contact numbers are included in the verified records.
Personal/residential numbers are not intentionally included.
Blank arrays mean no telephone number was published in the cited source; they do not mean the office has no phone.
Numbers are strings to preserve formatting and leading zeroes.
Use source_id and verification_status to evaluate confidence and freshness.
Legacy contacts are kept in a separate appendix and must not be treated as currently verified.
